newsitem.title: FRANCE: Failure of Albania deal a disaster - Commission.
newsitem.headline: Failure of Albania deal a disaster - Commission.

text.p: The European Commission appealed to the political forces in Albania on Wednesday to stick strictly to the terms of a potential compromise, warning the country could collapse if they did not.

"One thing is clear, if the compromise doesn't stand, doesn't hold up, then things will get much worse in Albania and there will be an uncontrolled rebellion," warned Hans van den Broek, the European commissioner responsible for relations with central and eastern Europe.

Van den Broek told the European Parliament the Albanian President, Sali Berisha, and the country's opposition parties were considering a deal to form a transitional government of national unity which would lead the country to general elections in June.
But the opposition had warned that unless Barisha resigned, it would be impossible to put a halt to the rebellion in the south by groups opposed to the president.
If the rebels refused to lay down their arms, this would be a clear breach of the hoped-for accord, van den Broek said.
It was up to Barisha and the opposition to ensure both sides respected the agreement absolutely, the Dutch commissioner said.
"If that doesn't happen, then we fear Albania has a very bleak future ahead of it," he said, adding that the chief victims of such an outcome would be the Albanian people.
The European Parliament is expected to pass a resolution on Thursday condemning the escalation of violence in Albania and urging all sides to find "a peaceful and democratic solution" to the crisis.
